text:
mike_sales: Riverbend SEC sent the SIG, wants per-question evidence. I answered top-level but need artifacts for Q12 (KMS), Q27 (audit logs), Q41 (pen test), Q58 (data residency). Who can help?
priya_k: I can handle KMS. Paste their sheet link?
mike_sales: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SALES/pages/RIVERBEND/SIG (tab RIVERBEND_SIG)
alex_w: Engsec bot can drop pen test and SOC2 redacted. @engsec-bot please upload.
engsec-bot: Uploaded: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/riverbend/RIVERBEND_SIG_pentest-summary.pdf, s3://redwood-sec-evidence/riverbend/RIVERBEND_SIG_soc2.pdf
sam_ops: For Q27 logs: prod retention 365d, non-prod 90d. Add confluence link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/Log+Retention. Sample CloudWatch query:
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter service="inference-runtime" and level="ERROR"
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 25
```
priya_k: KMS note: Dedicated/Private support customer-managed CMKs; hosted uses envelope encryption. Uploading policy JSON now.
priya_k: CLI to extract key usage from CloudTrail (pasteable):
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey --start-time 2026-01-01 --end-time 2026-03-31 > key_events.json
```
alex_w: Q58: Riverbend asks EU-only backup. For Dedicated we can pin eu-west-1 and hold backups in customer VPC. Diagram: https://redwood.app/diagrams/riverbend-backup.png. Backup policy uploaded.
mike_sales: Please prefix uploads with RIVERBEND_SIG_. Also mark NDA-only artifacts.
engsec-bot: Artifacts uploaded with prefix and NDA flags where required.
priya_k: Draft answers: Q12 "CMKs supported for Dedicated/Private; envelope encryption for hosted. See attached policy."
sam_ops: Q27 draft: "Logs retained 365 days (prod), retention policy and sample query attached."
alex_w: Q41 draft: "Annual third-party penetration test; redacted summary attached. Full report available under NDA."
mike_sales: I'll attach everything to the sheet and send back to Riverbend today. Ping me if you want to join the security walkthrough.
